card.name: Linking words before monitoring or counseling advice
card.fires_on: The ending "itates" in "necessitates" in opioid and benzodiazepine risk statements. Also "and" or a comma after a prescribing or dosing instruction, just before a follow-up verb such as monitor or follow closely.

modes.label: necessitates counseling
modes.description: The word piece "itates" completing "necessitates" before counseling about risks in opioid or benzodiazepine labels.
modes.example: use in such patients necess<<itates>> intensive counseling about the risks and proper use

modes.label: and/comma before monitoring
modes.description: A joining word or comma after an assess, dose or start instruction, where a monitoring clause comes next.
modes.example: Assess the risk of abuse prior to prescribing,<< and>> monitor for signs of abuse and dependence while

card.writes: It suppresses monitor, watch and supervise words, so it makes a following monitoring verb less likely.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a label where a sentence turns to counseling or follow-up advice.
